title: Fruitist continues expanding packaged fresh fruit business with $150 million raise
summary: Reports a US$150 million equity financing led by JP Morgan, dated 10 November 2025, and refers to Steve Magami as co-founder and chief executive.
why_it_matters: Capital of this size flowing to a licensee rather than to a breeder indicates where the sector currently expects returns: in supply chain and packaging rather than in genetics ownership.

commercial_position.rationale: Funds further expansion by a major buyer of licensed genetics.
